items.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost After Investor Day Reset
items.summary: The updated analyst fair value estimate for Qualcomm has shifted from US$168.50 to US$221.23, signaling a reset in how the stock’s long term potential is being framed. This move lines up with fresh research after Qualcomm’s Investor Day, where opinions split between enthusiasm for its AI data center and non handset targets, and caution around competition, handset demand, and licensing risks. items.title: MU Vs Its Peers: A Lead With A Price Tag
items.summary: After a stunning +749% run over the last twelve months, Micron Technology (MU) stock has recently pulled back, trading at about $959.48 a share. The company sits at the heart of the AI buildout, supplying the critical memory chips that power modern data centers. Yet for investors, its position within its competitive group presents a puzzle. Micron trades at a premium 44.8 times earnings, more expensive than rival NVIDIA's 32.3 multiple, but its operating margin of 48% doesn't reach NVIDIA's 64.
